visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens in a brightly lit indoor living room at night. A beige leather recliner chair sits in the center, facing a wall-mounted TV showing a video call grid. To the left, a wooden shelf is packed with colorful yarn balls. A Marshall amplifier sits on the floor. (2) The shot shifts to a split-screen video call with four panels showing different people in their homes, laughing and gesturing. Bright yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom, indicating the date. (3) Outside in a modern shopping area, a woman with long black hair in a beige coat walks alongside a young girl wearing a patterned knit cardigan and a cream scarf. They smile and talk directly to the camera while walking. (4) Inside a cat cafe with light wood decor, the girl sits on a gray fabric sofa petting a fluffy long-haired cat. In the background, cats are seen perched on high wooden walkways under a circular pink neon sign. (5) A close-up shot of a golden bowl filled with white tofu pudding (douhua) and golden-brown tapioca pearls. A spoon lifts a portion of the dessert toward the camera. (6) Handheld shots demonstrate a brown, fuzzy bear-shaped earphone case from the 'Cry Baby' series. Fingers rotate the object to show the 'POP MART' tag and the zipper opening. (7) Final shots show two black SUQQU lipstick cases on a white surface, followed by one being opened to reveal a red lipstick refill without the outer casing.
